Topic: Sports competitions


Many people question whether sports are beneficial or harmful to children's development. This is not an easy question to answer. Sports are often understood as inherently competitive, which makes it debatable whether they are good or bad. However, when the competitive element is excluded, sports play a crucial role in children's development. They provide opportunities for socializing and learning essential life skills that are not typically taught in the classroom, such as teamwork, communication, and resilience.

On the other hand, competitive sports can have negative effects. By this, I mean that constantly comparing one child to another to determine who is better or worse can be harmful. Many students thrive in neutral, active environments where cooperation is encouraged, rather than in competitive settings. It is extremely important to recognize that sports are essential for children's development, serving as a counterbalance to the academic focus of classrooms. Schools should view sports not as a means of fostering competition, but as a way to promote cooperation, physical wellness, and holistic growth.

Topic: Working from home


Working from home has its pros and cons, and I have mixed feelings about it. On one hand, I find that I work effectively without the distractions of my colleagues chatting. However, later, I got distracted by other things around the house, such as the dirty laundry or the unwashed dishes. I can focus on my tasks and complete them much faster. It’s nice to set my own schedule and take breaks when I want. However, working from home is not as good as I expected. I sometimes feel lonely without the social interaction from the office. Topic: Security camera
I've noticed that some of my coworkers get a bit nervous about the security cameras in our office. They often say things like, 'It feels like we're being watched all the time,' or 'I don't like feeling like I'm not trusted.' But honestly, I think people worry too much about it. These cameras aren't there to spy on us or catch us doing something wrong. They're actually there to keep us safe. I mean, think about it - if something were to happen, like a theft or an accident, wouldn't you want there to be a record of it? Plus, knowing the cameras are there can actually prevent bad things from happening in the first place. I believe that once people understand the real purpose of these cameras, they'll feel much better about them. Instead of feeling worried, we should feel glad that our company cares about our safety. It's just one more way they're looking out for us while we're at work. You know, I remember when we first got the cameras installed. Some people were really upset about it. But after a while, most of us hardly even notice them anymore. They're just part of the background now. And there have been times when they've been really helpful. Like when someone's bag went missing, the cameras helped us figure out what happened. I think it's important to remember that these cameras are in public areas, not in private spaces like bathrooms or changing rooms. They're not meant to invade our privacy, just to make sure everyone follows the rules and stays safe. In the end, I think having them makes our workplace better for everyone. It's a small thing that can make a big difference in keeping us all secure.

    Nhưng thành thật mà nói, tôi nghĩ mọi người lo lắng quá mức về chuyện này. Những chiếc camera này không được lắp đặt để theo dõi chúng ta hay bắt quả tang chúng ta làm điều gì sai. Thực ra, chúng được sử dụng để giữ cho chúng ta an toàn.

    Hãy thử nghĩ xem – nếu có chuyện gì xảy ra, chẳng hạn như một vụ trộm hoặc một tai nạn, chẳng phải bạn sẽ muốn có một đoạn ghi hình về sự việc đó sao? Hơn nữa, việc biết rằng có camera ở đó thực sự có thể ngăn những điều xấu xảy ra ngay từ đầu.

    Tôi tin rằng một khi mọi người hiểu được mục đích thực sự của những chiếc camera này, họ sẽ cảm thấy tốt hơn về chúng. Unfortunately, at La Bella Bistro, that element was noticeably lacking, and it's something they need to address if they hope to stand out in today's competitive market.
